registered: round 76, 2026-10-26, BEFORE the first model call of batch v4 (smoke cell included: any model call of round 76 happens only after this file is committed)
question: In the live system (real model channel, `vacant run` gate), does arm B (retry=resample, max-attempts=3, restart driven by the visible suite) accept more runs than arm A (retry=none), on the full 34-task polyglot_py bank?
why_this_row: For polyglot_py the visible tests ARE the grader (test text is in the prompt; suite runs the same test class), so resample-on-visible-failure is the valid real-signal row, NOT the upper-bound scorer row (round 67 guard test pins this). Offline replay of this same row (round 67, ref/offline_restart_sim.py over ref/c37_final.json): polyglot_py 37.3 -> 47.0% (+9.7pp, n=68 units with >=2 independent runs; ALL 62.3 -> 66.4%, +4.1pp, n=331). v3 (round 74, n=18 pairs) was UNRESOLVED at p=0.0625 with 3/3 reps direction-consistent; this is the pre-registered, higher-n confirmation attempt on the same row.

outcome: per-run summary.accepted (visible suite passed). Refusals count as failures (in the denominator). infra_void runs (model channel failed) are dropped from denominators and reported separately; never back-filled.

analysis.primary_unit: (task, rep) pair; n_pairs = 102; n_runs per arm = 102 (204 total)
analysis.primary_statistic: exact two-sided McNemar on discordant pairs via vacant_network.research.mcnemar_exact(b, c); b = (A pass, B fail), c = (A fail, B pass)
analysis.per_rep: descriptive: (b, c, p) per rep; same direction across all 3 reps with none passing correction is UNRESOLVED, not negative, not positive
analysis.power_note: n=102 is adequately powered for the expected effect size: if the true effect is +9.7pp on a ~50% baseline (A 51/102, B 61/102, discordants roughly b=2, c=10) the exact two-sided McNemar p is ~0.04; with b=0, c=8, p=0.0078. UNRESOLVED remains a legitimate state (H-12).
not_done: no pooling of v1/v2/v3 into v4 (separate registered/unregistered batches)
no pooling of independent batches into one manufactured n
no hidden-suite/scorer signal enters the arm decision (round 67 guard test pins this)
no post-hoc task selection: all 34 tasks count, including any that both arms fail

decision_states.EFFECTIVE: c > b AND p < 0.05 -> may state: B accepted more than A on this batch (n=102 pairs, 34 tasks x 3 reps), direction-consistent with the offline real-signal row (polyglot_py +9.7pp, n=68) and the v3 direction (3/3 reps). May NOT state 'proves better' (one batch, one model, H-12).
decision_states.CONTRADICTS: c < b AND p < 0.05 -> no effect claim in EITHER direction; investigate. 'the loop is harmful' is NOT a pre-registered conclusion (R532 AMEND1 direction guard: a significant result in the opposite direction has no pre-registered state and draws no harm conclusion).
decision_states.UNRESOLVED: otherwise (including c > b with p >= 0.05) -> record direction and magnitude only; a null here is not a negative result.
decision_states.INCOMPLETE: fewer than the 3 registered reps present at analysis time -> resume the incomplete (task, arm, rep) cells (the runner skips completed cells; resume is infrastructure, not a design change) and analyze only once all 3 registered reps exist. If the batch cannot be completed (model slot down, disk, etc.), report completed reps descriptively only; no decision state assigned; partial batch is neither clean nor dirty.

known_caveats: single model, single slot, 34 tasks: does not transfer to another model/harness/budget/corpus without re-running (H-12)

the model channel is a single slot shared with the loop harness; wall times are not a metric and long model calls serialize (v3 observed 4-14s/run on the 6 small tasks; the 28 additional tasks include larger ones, so the v4 batch may span two rounds — the INCOMPLETE/resume rule above governs)
max_tokens=4096 per attempt: a truncated answer is a legitimate failure of the attempt, not infra_void; both arms face the same ceiling
v1 (3/6 vs 2/6), v2 (4/6 vs 4/6) remain unregistered smoke evidence and v3 (n=18, UNRESOLVED) is its own registered batch; this prereg does not pool them and does not retroactively cover them
